title: Buttons | Apple Developer Documentation - [visionOS](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/buttons\#visionOS)
claim: Choose the right shape if you need to display text-labeled buttons in a stack or row.** Specifically, prefer the rounded-rectangle shape in a vertical stack of buttons and prefer the capsule shape in a horizontal row of buttons.
supporting_text: **Choose the right shape if you need to display text-labeled buttons in a stack or row.** Specifically, prefer the rounded-rectangle shape in a vertical stack of buttons and prefer the capsule shape in a horizontal row of buttons.
